text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(My legs are heavy, my lungs are burning...!
The goal is still so, so far away—!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (...Still! I've made it this far! I can do this too, I know I can!)
Haaaaaaaaaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The Kikuka Sho Umamusume is Dantsu Flame!
It's Dantsu Flameeee!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa!
*gasp*, *cough*! ...Khh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I won, I won... I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has proven herself as the strongest Umamusume of her generation!
Dantsu Flame clinches a magnificent victory!!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Man, that was magnificent! Thrilling! It was purely and simply a race among the strongest Umamusume! However—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe! Her stamina—and her
temperament as a stayer—really stood
out! I can't wait to see her in future long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Cafe... chan...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...She likely gave it her absolute all, and the tension simply snapped once it was over. There are no injuries or abnormalities.
Just to be safe, please have her rest for a few days.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I was just tired, that's all.
Sorry for causing a fuss."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Still, we won, Trainer-san!
It really feels like a dream...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
It's all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no.
It's... just—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's pathetic to admit, but when it comes to Long-distance races...
I might not be able to push myself any harder than that.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I really gave it my all, completely lost in the moment...
Like I surpassed my absolute limit.
Winning almost feels like a miracle to me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Driven purely by the desire to win the Kikuka Sho,
I've pushed forward this far, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I might not really be suited
for long distances after all.
Especially anything over 3000m...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...For the Senior Year, I wanted to aim for
the classic Spring and Autumn Senior Triple Crowns.
But given the circumstances--

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! I'm sorry.
Shall we... try again tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I mean, look, we should celebrate today for now! You gave it everything you had. You worked super hard and won fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Great work in the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That night,
a certain "comment" became a hot topic.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Isn't she magnificent, “Manhattan Cafe”...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think being a commentator was my style,
but with such great seats, it's truly exhilarating.
Yeah, I'm glad I took the job!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—She has finally awakened. I had high hopes
for her from the start, but her body was rather frail, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, she gained immense strength over the summer! She's bound to make even greater leaps forward! I can already picture her storming past the pack with that powerhouse physique!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She is truly a bundle of potential—
an Umamusume who will inherit my will
and stand at the center of the era!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's impassioned words fired up
the other celebrity commentators as well.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text: She was a total dark horse! Seeing her run like that... really struck a chord with me.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality B
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the future.
Just how well will she do in the Senior Class!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, that wave
even began spreading to the public...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"‘Man, that really was amazing, Cafe!
And you barely even squeaked into the Kikuka Sho to begin with’—"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Voices
text_block_list.text:
"Dantsu collapsed, but Cafe looked totally unfazed."
"Look closely, doesn't she kind of resemble that legendary Umamusume?"
"Can't wait for the Spring-Autumn Senior Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Kikuka Sho, Dantsu Flame should have had
the ability to stand right in the center.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She ran with the resolve to surpass Jungle Pocket,
and the sheer amount of effort she put in was beyond reproach. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before the overwhelming long-distance aptitude of the dark horse, Manhattan Cafe—and the shining potential it held—she had been overshadowed once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, the exact same thing happened in every single race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yearning for the 'lead role,' running full tilt—
and yet, still failing to capture the people's hearts."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was already the middle of the night,
but unable to bear it any longer, I called her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Dantsu Flame
never answered the phone.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, out of nowhere...
And I couldn't even answer your call, either.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. Do you have a moment right now?
There's something I'd like to consult you about."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I saw that the media and social networks
were buzzing all about Cafe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I spent all night thinking about it
in my own way, and—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Would you allow me to run
in the Mile Championship
for our next race?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: In the Senior Class, I want to focus on the mile and medium distances that suit me best!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can truly become the star of the show
on a stage where I can shine in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...It will be an unconventional challenge, but with proper adjustments, it is well within reason. I understand her desire to achieve results in races tailored to her aptitudes."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, before that—
Seeing how unexpectedly cheerful she seemed,
I felt the tension leave me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah...
Umm, that is—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, you see...
The truth is... last night, I was actually thinking about quitting altogether.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I amounted to nothing
in the Classic campaign, so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Even when it comes to distance, it turns out
I'm probably not suited for the classic route.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: And a radiance that makes one reluctant to see it go.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: As well as the star power to start a movement.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: A potential that inspires great hopes for the future, too—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"There wasn't. There really wasn't.
I guess taking this whole year made me realize that."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I was pretty bummed out.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I even found myself thinking... maybe I should just
give up on being the "lead"... on being at "center stage"—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, it was no good after all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I should just give up already.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Give up, talk to Trainer, and then—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *cough*, *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I feel kind of gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So I took it back right away.
No matter how steep the path is,
I won't give up~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: If I keep working hard in my own plain way, I'm sure someone out there will notice.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Once I made up my mind, it felt like a weight was lifted.
So I'm totally fine now!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: To keep building momentum from here on, I really want to leave behind a solid result at the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dants Flame declares with a radiant smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without leaving any room for me to intervene, she had already reset her mindset and moved forward.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So... I'd also like to hear
what you think about it, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To her, the dream of being the "leading star" is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's not something she doesn't want to give up, but something she simply cannot give up.
choice_data_list: (No matter what happens, she won't stop chasing her goal.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No matter what happens, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is Dantsu Flame's choice,
the Mile Championship."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with her and her renewed resolve,
next time, we'll claim center stage for sure...!
